summary: Explains imports are pre-processed before any tasks run, so they aren't affected by other tasks; imported file names can be templated only with variables available at parse time (vars or --extra-vars). Shows importing the same file multiple times with different vars.
questions: Can I use a variable in an import_tasks filename?
How do I import the same task file several times with different values?
Are imports affected by earlier task results?

answer_card.title: Imports: static reuse
answer_card.answer_md:
Imports are pre-processed **before** any task runs, so they're never affected by other tasks. File names can be templated only with variables available at parse time (`vars` or `--extra-vars`).

To run one file several times, pass different variables:

```yaml
- import_tasks: wordpress.yml
  vars:
    wp_user: timmy
- import_tasks: wordpress.yml
  vars:
    wp_user: alice
```
